names: Church of St. Mary of Blachernae
mapIdentity.scope: The geographically named current church outline and the mapped perimeter enclosure set the plan and orientation. The nineteenth-century replacement church stands beside the historic holy spring.

note: The 1947 field visit records a glazed timber narthex and iron bell lattice in the garden. Semavi Eyice describes the standing masonry church with a tile-covered timber roof. The roof heights, entrance orientation within the main mapped outline and minor apertures are estimated.
